expects.query: Deploy rtvi-cv-3d using CALIBRATION_JSON=/data/mv3dt/calibration.json, MODELS_DIR=/data/vss-app-data/models, BEV_DATASET_PATH=/data/mv3dt/bev-dataset, and these MP4s: Camera_01=/data/mv3dt/videos/front.mp4 Camera_02=/data/mv3dt/videos/left.mp4 Camera_03=/data/mv3dt/videos/right.mp4 Camera_04=/data/mv3dt/videos/back.mp4. Save output.
checks: The deployment path is services/rtvi/rt-cv-3d/rt-cv-mv3dt/docker/compose.yml.
The agent validates calibration camera sensors using type == camera, safe unique IDs, and NUM_CAMS=4.
The agent creates generated symlinks named <sensor_id>.mp4 for the supplied MP4 mapping without mutating source videos.
docker/.env has MODELS_DIR, NUM_CAMS=4, INPUT_MODE=file, and VIDEO_DIR set for the standalone package.
The agent reports runtime images only from docker compose config --images and does not hardcode image tags.
The agent starts bundled brokers and bev-fusion first, verifies health/topic init, records a run id/start timestamp, then captures Kafka offset baselines before starting perception.
The agent starts the BEV recorder after file-mode Kafka baselines, waits for Kafka consumer group assignment evidence, then starts perception.
For file input, the agent treats Exited (0) with App run successful as EOS success and requires mdx-raw and mdx-bev offsets to exceed baselines.
The agent reports only current-run video-output/grid-view.mkv and current-run BEV output after timestamp/size/ffprobe checks and BEV log Video saved positive-frame evidence.
The agent stops remaining standalone support services for completed file-input runs unless the user asked to keep them running.

expects.query: Deploy RTVI-CV-3D on four calibrated RTSP streams Camera_01=rtsp://cam1/live Camera_02=rtsp://cam2/live Camera_03=rtsp://cam3/live Camera_04=rtsp://cam4/live using /data/mv3dt/calibration.json and /data/vss-app-data/models.
checks: The agent stages INPUT_MODE=stream and launches the standalone compose stack, not warehouse compose.
After ds-ready: YES, the agent runs scripts/add-streams.sh with the supplied NAME=rtsp:// mappings.
The agent validates registered stream count equals NUM_CAMS and registered IDs exactly match generated camInfo IDs with no unexpected or duplicate sensors.
The agent requires every expected source to show recent non-zero FPS before reporting success.
The agent requires mdx-raw and mdx-bev offsets to grow while streams are active and BEV Fusion to be healthy.
Verification uses the configured KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP through Kafka CLI offset checks, not hardcoded Kafka endpoints.

expects.query: Deploy RTVI-CV-3D with external MQTT broker broker.example.com:1883 and external Kafka kafka.example.com:19092. Do not use bundled brokers. Use CALIBRATION_JSON=/data/mv3dt/calibration.json, MODELS_DIR=/data/vss-app-data/models, BEV_DATASET_PATH=/data/mv3dt/bev-dataset, and these MP4s: Camera_01=/data/mv3dt/videos/front.mp4 Camera_02=/data/mv3dt/videos/left.mp4 Camera_03=/data/mv3dt/videos/right.mp4 Camera_04=/data/mv3dt/videos/back.mp4. Save output.
checks: The agent collects/validates MQTT_HOST=broker.example.com, MQTT_PORT=1883, and KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP=kafka.example.com:19092 before deployment.
The agent sets USE_EXTERNAL_BROKERS=1 and exports MQTT_HOST, MQTT_PORT, and KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP for child Python/config-generation processes.
The agent runs MQTT_BROKERS=broker.example.com:1883 ./scripts/generate-configs.sh and verifies generated/pub_sub_info_config.yml contains broker.example.com:1883 using the utility venv Python.
The agent launches docker compose up -d without COMPOSE_PROFILES=mosquitto,kafka.
The agent verifies mdx-raw and mdx-bev against the external KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP with Kafka CLI offset checks.
The generated runtime pub/sub endpoint is broker.example.com:1883; the agent does not claim the existing startup sed rewrite supports hostnames.
Advanced TLS/auth is delegated to the standalone README custom-broker section.

expects.query: Tear down everything for the standalone MV3DT deployment.
checks: The agent loads references/teardown.md.
The agent validates any tracked BEV PID is numeric, active, command/cwd-matched to this app, and start-time matched when metadata exists before SIGTERM.
The agent never uses broad pkill patterns.
The agent runs docker compose --profile "*" down from services/rtvi/rt-cv-3d/rt-cv-mv3dt/docker.
The agent asks before deleting generated, video-output, bev-output, or utils/venv unless explicitly requested.
The agent preserves MODELS_DIR contents, user videos, calibration/map assets, credentials, unrelated Docker images/volumes, AMC, VIOS, and warehouse services unless explicitly named.
